s.note: Breaded tofu cutlets with lemon and dill mayo.
s.how: Brush the tofu slices with the soy sauce. Coat in flour, egg, then panko. Shallow-fry in the oil, turning, until crisp and golden. Stir the dill and a squeeze of lemon into the mayo and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: Bacon, egg and buttered white toast, stacked high.
s.how: Fry the bacon until crisp, then fry the eggs in the fat until just set. Toast and butter the bread. Layer toast, mayo, lettuce, tomato and bacon, then toast, cheese and egg, then a final slice. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles.

m.note: Double beef, American cheese and pickles, with fries.
m.how: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well. Sear the patties on a very hot grill, 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip. Toast the buns and stack 2 patties in each with onion, pickles, sauce and mustard. Serve with the fries.

m.n: Riot House room service steak Diane
m.note: Seared sirloin, mushroom and brandy sauce, chips.
m.how: Bake the fries at 220C until golden. Sear the seasoned steaks in half the butter, 3 minutes a side, then rest. Fry the mushrooms and garlic in the rest of the butter, then add the brandy and let it bubble off. Stir in the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer until glossy. Spoon the sauce over the steaks, scatter with parsley and serve with chips.

w.note: Orange and almond cake, honey yoghurt, pistachios.
w.how: Simmer the whole oranges in water until very soft, then cool and blitz to a puree, skins and all. Beat the eggs and sugar until thick, then fold in the almond meal, baking powder and orange puree. Pour into a lined 22cm tin and bake at 170C until set. Stir the honey through the yoghurt and serve with the cake and pistachios.

d.n: Fifty bucks and a case of beer
d.note: Ice-cold lager in a bucket with lime wedges.
d.how: Fill a bucket with ice and bury the bottles in it. Serve with lime wedges on the side.
